title: 1988 Fleer Baseball Card Jay Aldrich Rookie Milwaukee Brewers #155
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1988 Fleer Baseball Card featuring Jay Aldrich, a rookie player for the Milwaukee Brewers. This original trading card is part of the Fleer Baseball Card set and measures 3½" x 2½". While it is not autographed, it is a collectible item for fans of baseball and card collectors. As a piece of sports memorabilia, this card captures a moment in the career of Jay Aldrich during the 1988 season.
